label: Headwear
description: Named hats, caps, headwraps, scarves, veils, crowns and practical head coverings.
notes: Head coverings and wearable headpieces belong here, including ceremonial crowns and practical protective headwear. Hairstyles belong in person.hairstyle; earrings, necklaces and other jewelry belong in person.accessory. Each value names one item after wearing, with no specified color or brand. Traditional names describe the covering rather than the wearer’s descent, and revivable hat styles remain available in contemporary scenes.
